presentation.name: Add a first Docker setup to a Python data project
presentation.summary: Adds a first working Docker setup to a Python data project, with its dependencies as Compose services.
benefits: Creates .dockerignore, Dockerfile and compose.yaml together so the first build is clean
Runs databases and brokers as pinned containers instead of host installs
Defaults to loopback ports and a documented development-only credential
Confirms the stack actually starts before calling the scaffold done
